newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 2.2 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 2.2 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 62,753 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended Dec 7, up 2.2 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of power supplied to the Rocky Mountain area rose the most from a year ago, up 10 percent to 3,198 GWh, EEI said.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 3.31 million GWh, up 2.6 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
